doc: Blind rerun (I96): the seeds file of spec/M3/lib/sort_types.json (holon.sorts.extracted, rule E3), written from the pinned checkout's contracts/contracts/l1/rollup/Rollup.sol only. Two term seeds give the EVM environment its sorts (block.timestamp is a time point, msg.value an amount of the native asset); flow and the affine table carry them to the families and parameters that store, add or compare them (startTime, originTimestamp, finalizeTimestamp, finalizationPeriodSeconds, proofWindow, rollupDelayPeriod; challengeDeposit, batchChallengeReward, proveRemaining). The lexical seeds name the families whose declarations say what they hold: the *BatchIndex counters (lastFinalizedBatchIndex, lastCommittedBatchIndex, legacyCutoverBatchIndex) are batch indices, and the bytes32 values of the batchIndex-keyed mappings are named batchHash (committedBatches), stateRoot (finalizedStateRoots, committedStateRoots) and blobVersionedHash (batchBlobVersionedHashes). No writer-label rule: labels take the documented fallback.
